onboarding_welcome_desc: Your personal digital twin and universal identity engine. All sensitive data is encrypted and stored locally.
onboarding_vault_dir_desc: On Android, app data is deleted when the app is uninstalled. Choose an external directory to keep your data safe even after uninstalling.
onboarding_vault_dir_local_desc: Data is stored inside the app and will be deleted when uninstalled (default).
onboarding_vault_dir_saf_desc: Data is stored in a user-selected external directory and persists after uninstall. Recommended.
onboarding_vault_dir_restart_desc: The vault directory has changed. Please restart the app to use the new directory.
onboarding_vault_dir_pick_failed: Failed to get the selected folder result. Please try again.
onboarding_vault_dir_sync_hint: Please do not exit the app
onboarding_existing_accounts_desc: There are {{count}} account(s) in this vault directory. What would you like to do?
onboarding_create_object_desc: Create objects from Identity, Travel, Financial, or Professional pages, and use templates to organize your data.
onboarding_templates_desc: System templates include ID card, passport, bank account, and more. You can also customize templates in Template Manager.
onboarding_security_desc: Set up your master password, biometrics, and auto-lock to keep your vault secure.
onboarding_finish_desc: You've completed the onboarding guide. You can reopen it anytime from the Help page.
onboarding_account_source_title: Already have an account on another device?
onboarding_account_source_desc: If SoloSoul is already set up on another phone or computer, you can securely transfer your account over the local network. Otherwise, create a new account.
onboarding_account_source_sync: Yes, restore account from another device
trash_desc: View and manage deleted objects, restore or permanently purge
ocr_desc: Scan images for text, quickly extract and create objects
search_desc: Globally search objects, profiles, and help docs
settings_desc: Manage account, theme, security, and preferences
templates_desc: Create, edit, and manage object templates
attachments_desc: Manage attachment uploads, downloads, and trash
no_photos: No photos yet. Add some photo attachments first.
import_export_desc: Export or import encrypted vault packages
sync_desc: Sync vault data with nearby devices over the local network

ai_chat_desc: Chat with the AI assistant for suggestions and help

first_install_banner: Plugin system is in active development

attachment_limit_single_size_behavior: The oversized attachment will not be exported
attachment_limit_single_count_behavior: Excess attachments will not be saved
attachment_limit_total_size_behavior: Reduce attachments or export in batches
drag_guide_step1_desc: In the workspace list, drag and drop files directly onto any object card to attach them. The card will highlight when hovered during a drag.
drag_guide_step2_desc: Click an object card to open the detail panel. Drag files into the panel area to attach them to the current object.
drag_guide_step3_desc: In the attachment manager dialog, drag files directly into the window to batch upload multiple attachments at once.
guide_card_step1_desc: Each object card shows a template icon, object name, and category label at the top. If the object is linked to a template, the template name is also shown. Action buttons on the right: History (clock), Attachments (paperclip), Edit (pencil), Delete (trash). The card body displays field properties as labeled chips.
guide_card_step2_desc: Field border colors indicate sensitivity levels: 🟢 Green = Public, 🔵 Blue = Internal, 🟠 Amber = Sensitive, 🔴 Red = Critical. Non-public field values are automatically blurred to protect privacy.
guide_card_step3_desc: Click anywhere on the card to open the detail panel. Use the top-right buttons to: view version history, manage attachments, edit the object, or delete it. Drag and drop files onto the card to quickly add attachments.
guide_tpl_step1_desc: A template defines the data structure of an object, with a set of fields. Each field has a name, type (text, number, date, select, etc.), and sensitivity level. When creating an object using a template, the matching fields are generated automatically.
guide_tpl_step2_desc: Go to Settings > Template Manager to view all available templates, create new ones, or edit field structures. You can choose icons, assign pages, reorder fields, and set sensitivity levels. Deprecated fields can be restored or permanently cleaned up.
guide_tpl_step3_desc: When creating a new object, select a template to quickly populate data. You can change or replace the template later. If a template is deleted, existing object data is preserved — the template name is shown with strikethrough.
guide_help_getting_started_desc: Learn the basics of SoloSoul and workspace navigation
guide_help_attachments_desc: Upload, download, rename, and manage attachments in trash
guide_help_sensitivity_desc: Understand different sensitivity levels and security policies
guide_help_objects_desc: Create, edit, history rollback, and trash management for objects
guide_help_templates_desc: Create, edit, field management, and deprecation of templates
guide_help_create_object_desc: Use templates to create objects with pre-defined structures
guide_help_device_sync_desc: Pair devices over LAN and keep data in sync
guide_help_export_import_desc: Encrypted export and import of your vault data
guide_help_trash_desc: Restore or permanently delete trashed items
guide_plugin_step1_desc: Use the tabs to view all, installed, running, or log entries. Tier filters help you find plugins by phase.
guide_plugin_step2_desc: Install a plugin from the market, then run it. Some plugins require parameters or consent before execution.
guide_plugin_step3_desc: Update, uninstall, or stop plugins as needed. Refresh the registry to see the latest available plugins.
guide_help_plugins_desc: Discover, install, and run plugins in SoloSoul
guide_template_step1_desc: Browse templates by page category. Use the search and page filters to find the template you need.
guide_template_step2_desc: Create a new template or edit an existing one. Define fields, types, and sensitivity levels.
guide_template_step3_desc: Use the sample template gallery to quickly add commonly used templates to your vault.
guide_attachment_step1_desc: Attachments are grouped by page and object. Expand pages and objects to find the files you need.
guide_attachment_step2_desc: Upload new attachments or download existing ones. On mobile, select files from your device.
guide_attachment_step3_desc: Soft delete attachments to move them to trash, restore them later, or permanently delete them.
guide_backup_step1_desc: Create a local backup of your current profile. Backups are stored on this device.
guide_backup_step2_desc: Select a backup and restore it. Restoring may overwrite existing data in the current profile.
guide_backup_step3_desc: View backup details, delete old backups, or recover from a previous state.
guide_help_backup_restore_desc: Create and restore local profile backups
guide_search_step1_desc: Type keywords to search across objects, fields, and attachments. Use quoted phrases for exact matches.
guide_search_step2_desc: Filter results by sensitivity, object type, or date to narrow down the matches.
guide_search_step3_desc: Tap a result to open the object detail. You can edit or copy values from the detail view.
guide_help_search_desc: Search objects, fields, and attachments across the vault
guide_ai_chat_step1_desc: Choose a configured AI provider or add a new one in settings. Local and remote providers are supported.
guide_ai_chat_step2_desc: Create a new conversation or continue an existing one. Ask questions based on your vault data.
guide_ai_chat_step3_desc: Rename, delete, or archive conversations. Review token usage and model statistics.
guide_help_ai_chat_desc: Chat with AI using your local vault data
guide_ocr_step1_desc: Take a photo with the camera or select an image from your device. OCR extracts text from the image.
guide_ocr_step2_desc: Pick an OCR model tier based on accuracy and speed. Larger tiers are more accurate but slower.
guide_ocr_step3_desc: Review the recognized text and import it as a new object. You can also copy or edit the result.
guide_help_ocr_scan_desc: Scan images and import recognized text as objects
guide_detail_step1_desc: Drag files from your file manager directly into this detail panel to attach them. The panel will highlight when dragged over.
guide_detail_step2_desc: Click the Attachments button to open the manager, or drag files directly into the manager window for batch upload.
guide_detail_mobile_step1_desc: The detail card lists every field of the object. Each field shows its name, type icon, and a sensitivity badge. Values for Sensitive/Critical fields are blurred by default to protect your privacy.
guide_detail_mobile_step2_desc: Tap the eye icon next to a Sensitive field to reveal its value. Critical fields require authentication — tap the lock icon and verify with your password, PIN, or biometric to unlock the value temporarily.
guide_detail_mobile_step3_desc: Use the buttons at the bottom: History (clock) shows version snapshots; Attachments (paperclip) manages files; Edit (pencil) opens the editor; Delete (trash) moves the object to trash.
home_guide_step1_desc: Profile sections include Identity, Travel, Financial, and Professional predefined pages, plus any custom pages you create. Click a card to open its workspace.
home_guide_step2_desc: Quick access cards provide shortcuts to Settings, Trash, Search, Templates, Attachments, Plugins, OCR, Import/Export, Device Sync, Help, and AI Chat. Click a card to jump to that feature.
home_guide_step3_desc: Long-press a custom page card in the Profile Sections area to edit its icon, name, and description. Predefined pages and quick access cards cannot be edited.
guide_sync_step1_desc: Turn on sync to make your device discoverable and start listening on a local port. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
guide_sync_step2_desc: Tap Discover to scan for nearby devices. Tap Sync on a discovered device to pair, then verify the fingerprint to trust it.
guide_sync_step3_desc: Enable Automatic Sync to keep data in sync when the app is in the foreground, on data changes, and periodically.
guide_export_import_step1_desc: Choose the pages, objects, and tags you want to export. You can also include attachments, preferences, and behavioral data.
guide_export_import_step2_desc: Exports are encrypted with a password you provide. Keep the password safe — you will need it to import the package later.
guide_export_import_step3_desc: When importing, preview the package and choose how to handle duplicate objects: skip existing, overwrite, or decide per object.
guide_trash_step1_desc: Deleting an object or page moves it to trash instead of removing it immediately. Use time and type filters to find items.
guide_trash_step2_desc: Select items and tap Restore to recover them. Restoring a page may also restore its related objects.
guide_trash_step3_desc: Use the trash can button to permanently remove selected items. This action cannot be undone.
recovery_host_desc: Show this QR code or enter the address and PIN on your new device. Keep the app open until the transfer finishes.
recovery_host_localhost_warning: Could not detect your local network address. Please find this device's local IP manually and use it instead of 127.0.0.1.
recovery_host_qr_hint: Scan with the other device to connect automatically
recovery_host_manual_desc: On the other device, open "Recover from another device", choose the Manual tab, and enter:
recovery_host_manual_note: Keep this app open until the transfer completes. The session expires in 5 minutes.
sync_qr_show_desc: Scan this code with another logged-in SoloSoul device to pair and sync.
sync_qr_scan_desc: Point the camera at a SoloSoul sync or recovery QR code.
sync_qr_is_recovery: This is a recovery QR code. Please use it from the "Restore from another device" flow on the login page of a new device.
sync_scan_unsupported: This device does not support QR scanning. Use device discovery or manual input instead.
sync_qr_localhost_warning: Could not detect your local network address. The other device may need to use your actual local IP.
recovery_receive_scan_desc: On your old device, go to Settings → Device Sync → Show Recovery QR, then scan that QR code with this camera.
recovery_receive_desc: Enter the address and PIN shown on your old device, then continue.
recovery_account_card_desc_scan: Account detected on your old device. Set a new master password for this device, then start recovery.
recovery_account_card_desc_manual: Connection details confirmed. Set a new master password for this device, then start recovery.
recovery_qr_invalid_reverse: Invalid QR code. Please scan the recovery QR shown on your old device (Settings → Device Sync → Show Recovery QR).
recovery_qr_hint: Point your camera at the QR code shown on the other device.
recovery_qr_no_camera: No camera device found on this device. You can use manual entry to connect to your old device.
recovery_qr_permission_denied: Camera access is blocked. Please allow camera permission for SoloSoul in your system settings, then try again.
recovery_connect_timeout: Connection timed out. Make sure both devices are on the same network; on macOS/Windows, allow SoloSoul to accept incoming connections in the system firewall (macOS: System Settings → Network → Firewall → Firewall Options → add SoloSoul).
recovery_connect_refused: Connection refused. Make sure the recovery QR on the old device is still valid (within 5 minutes) and hasn't been used by another device, then scan again.
recovery_connect_unreachable: Network unreachable. Make sure both devices are on the same network (same Wi-Fi / LAN), then scan and try again.
recovery_host_closed_early: The host closed the connection before any data was sent: the recovery session may have ended (expired, cancelled, or already used by another device). Please tap "Show Recovery QR" again on the old device (Settings → Device Sync) and rescan.
recovery_too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts in a short period; the recovery service is temporarily limiting connections. Please wait about a minute and try again, or have the old device generate a new recovery QR.
recovery_invalid_pin: Invalid PIN or nonce: the QR may have expired or already been used, or the PIN entered is incorrect. Please have the old device generate a new recovery QR and try again.
recovery_mitm: Host identity verification failed — a man-in-the-middle attack may be in progress. Make sure the fingerprint shown on the old device matches what you entered, or regenerate the recovery QR.
recovery_handshake_failed: Handshake with the old device failed: the session may have been interrupted or expired. Please tap "Show Recovery QR" again on the old device and rescan.
recovery_transfer_failed: Data transfer interrupted: the connection dropped mid-transfer. Please generate a new recovery QR on the old device and scan again.
recovery_package_too_large: The recovery package exceeds the size limit and cannot be transferred. Consider removing unneeded data on the old device and try again.
recovery_task_failed: The recovery task failed (internal error). Please retry, or have the old device generate a new recovery QR.
no_account_unlocked: No account is currently unlocked. Please unlock an account first.
recovery_scan_unsupported: This device does not support QR scanning. Please use manual input mode.
onboarding_recover_from_device_desc: Restore your account from a phone or computer running SoloSoul.
recovery_progress_download: Downloading recovery data from the host…
recovery_progress_overwrite: Deleting the existing account on this device…
recovery_progress_create: Creating the account on this device…
recovery_complete_desc: Restored {{objects}} objects and {{attachments}} attachments from the old device. Return to the login page and unlock with your new password.
recovery_scan_no_hosts: No recovery hosts found on the network.
account_id_exists: This account already exists on this device. Please log in and use Device Sync instead.
recovery_id_conflict_title: This account already exists on this device
recovery_id_conflict_desc: Overwrite restore will permanently delete all data for this account on this device and replace it with the old device's data (can be used to reset this device's password). To keep this device's data, cancel and log in to use Device Sync instead.
recovery_overwrite_confirm_desc: All data for this account on this device will be overwritten and cannot be recovered. The old device's data will be imported after overwriting. This action cannot be undone.
recovery_overwrite_mode_note: Overwrite confirmed: after restore completes, the existing data for this account on this device will be replaced by the old device's data.
recovery_need_pin: Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the old device
tag_input_placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
